rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.
Use Outfit for a modern, punchy D2C feel and Manrope for clean, friendly body text.
Use #FDFDFB instead of pure white for consumer app background to give a warm, organic 'fresh linen' feel.
Pure white is reserved for high-elevation cards and the admin dashboard panels.
Avoid using dark colors as gradients. Keep the golden yellow (#D4A017) solid or subtly shaded.

consumer_app.padding: Use p-8 to p-12 for sections. Cards should have p-6.
consumer_app.border_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for a friendly, approachable aesthetic.

admin_dashboard.padding: Use tight gaps (gap-4) and crisp paddings (p-4 or p-6).
admin_dashboard.border_radius: rounded-lg for a utilitarian, professional look.

spacing_and_layout.grids: Follow the 'Bento Grid Protocol'. Never fill 100% of the screen perfectly on consumer pages; leave breathing room.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the sticky top navigation bar: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-black/5.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-black/5 on cards to crisp up the edges instead of relying only on shadows.

components.hero_section: Asymmetrical layout. Large 'Outfit' typography on the left. The Pincode checker should be prominent—a large input field rounded-full with a pill-shaped golden button. Right side features an immersive image with floating 'rating' or 'bubble' tags.
components.service_cards: Wash, Iron, Dry Clean. Don't just use standard Shadcn cards. Use soft beige/off-white background (#F7F6F2) with hover '-translate-y-1' and a subtle golden border on hover.
components.pincode_input: Pill-shaped, large padding, clear placeholder. Icon on the left (MapPin).
components.order_timeline: Vertical stepper. Use the golden yellow for active states, muted gray for pending. Keep lines thin (2px).
components.admin_tables: Use Shadcn Table. Strict alignment. Header text should be text-xs tracking-[0.1em] uppercase text-muted. Add 'Mark Complete' button as a compact, pill-shaped outline button that turns solid gold on hover.
components.dropdowns_and_modals: Never use fully transparent backgrounds. Must use solid white or glassmorphism to avoid text collision.

motion.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down slightly active:scale-95. Cards lift on hover -translate-y-1.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-up for lists (My Orders, Service Cards).

hero_background.description: Happy woman with laundry basket, bright clean lighting. Perfect for hero right side image.

iron_service.description: Close up of an iron on blue cloth

dry_clean_service.description: Crisp folded linen/towels in warm sunlight

instructions_to_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds.
NEVER apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep text naturally aligned left.
Use modern pill-shaped or squircle buttons with active animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use generous spacing (p-8 to p-12). Cramped designs look cheap.
ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over golden primary buttons is #111111 (Black) for optimal contrast, not white.
